procedure: Identify failure events for the actual decision, task and assertion; record causes, affected objects, consequences, current controls and evidence gaps. Separate inherent exposure from residual exposure and qualitative judgment from measured likelihood.

Bind every risk to a current plan node ID/revision and source, calculation, claim or artifact ID/hash. Map impact and control coverage to the proposed profile without converting unsupported estimates to probabilities.

Check package adoption and task settings separately. A profile stays shadow unless a concrete version/hash and scoped user adoption record exist. Missing sourcepack standards remain missing; do not invent normative thresholds.

acceptance.expectation: Current inputs and actual plan task/risk bindings are recorded; stale inputs return restricted results.
Named outputs reflect performed work, uncertainty and method-specific limits; risk evidence grants no authority.

conditions: Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; affected object, missing evidence/test, owner, next action and restriction
